W.note: Restrained line-icon cards with real variant chips, sold-out and loading/added/error states, and proper labeling, but the desktop layout is sparse with only three products and a text-only cart summary.

X.note: Full shop flow with search, filters, sort, quantity steppers and a totals drawer, but emoji art, tinted tiles and hover lift add clutter and the mobile header strands the Cart button on its own row.

Y.note: Clean line-icon cards with clear sold-out and sale states, but the cart is only a count with no review, quantity or checkout, and the mobile layout collapses to one wasteful column.

Z.note: Dense two-column mobile and five-column desktop grid with stock warnings, max-in-cart limits and a complete cart drawer with totals, though the per-card Add buttons lack product names and the emoji art softens the look.
